title: The President, His Plane and the Press

sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.zh: 我凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 太空探索七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60份超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最强的球队。

I use a different starting word every day.

sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来致力于帮助您了解世界，充分利用每一天。

sentences.zh: 立即订阅，获取nytimes.com/subscribe的特别优惠。

sentences.en: I was out for some drinks sitting on a patio.
sentences.zh: 我当时出去喝了几杯，坐在露台上。

sentences.en: My wife and I were over at some friend's house for dinner, you know, having a really nice evening, a glass of wine and all that.
sentences.zh: 我和妻子当时在朋友家吃晚饭，你知道的，度过了一个非常愉快的夜晚，喝了杯红酒之类的。

sentences.en: My family and I had sat down to watch sheep detectives, a murder mystery.
sentences.zh: 我和家人坐下来看《绵羊侦探》，一部谋杀悬疑片。

sentences.en: And right as we were about to find out from the sheep who had committed the murder,
sentences.zh: 就在我们快要从绵羊口中得知谁是凶手时，

sentences.en: I get a call.
sentences.zh: 我接到了一个电话。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Balbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日报道》节目。

sentences.en: And I pick it up and it's an FBI agent who identifies himself and says,
sentences.zh: 我接起电话，对方是一名联邦调查局探员，他自报家门说，

sentences.en: I'm in front of your house right now.
sentences.zh: 我现在就在你家门前。

sentences.en: Are you coming home anytime soon?
sentences.zh: 你很快要回家吗？

sentences.en: When I got home, my wife was in the front yard with our kids and they were playing with some sparklers left over from the July 4th celebration.
sentences.zh: 我到家时，妻子正和孩子们在前院，他们正在玩7月4日庆祝活动剩下的烟花棒。

sentences.en: And she pointed to this unusual car sitting there across the street from our house.
sentences.zh: 她指着街对面停着的一辆奇怪的车。

sentences.en: Inside were two FBI agents that were effectively staking us out.
sentences.zh: 里面坐着两名联邦调查局探员，实际上是在监视我们。

sentences.en: My son is at the front of the house looking through the window and he shouts, they're here.
sentences.zh: 我儿子在屋前透过窗户往外看，大喊道：他们来了。

sentences.en: Last Friday night, as my colleagues from the Washington Bureau of the Times settled into their weekend routines, FBI agents showed up at their homes.
sentences.zh: 上周五晚上，当《纽约时报》华盛顿分社的同事们开始享受周末时光时，联邦调查局探员出现在了他们家门口。

sentences.en: And the agent identifies himself and he basically says,
sentences.zh: 探员自报家门，基本上是说，

sentences.en: I'm serving you with this subpoena.
sentences.zh: 我给你送传票来了。

sentences.en: And summoned them to testify before a grand jury.
sentences.zh: 并传唤他们在大陪审团面前作证。

sentences.en: It was two sheets of paper.
sentences.zh: 那是两张纸。

sentences.en: I mean, it wasn't even the official signed document.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，那甚至不是正式的签字文件。

sentences.en: It was a photocopy of the subpoena.
sentences.zh: 那是传票的复印件。

sentences.en: The agents wouldn't say what the concern was.
sentences.zh: 探员们不肯说具体是什么问题。

sentences.en: But I had no doubt what story they were talking about.
sentences.zh: 但我毫不怀疑他们指的是哪篇报道。

sentences.en: They were talking about the Air Force One story.
sentences.zh: 他们说的是关于“空军一号”的那篇报道。

sentences.en: It was an extraordinary move by the Trump administration in response to a set of stories published by the Times about the safety of the new Air Force One.
sentences.zh: 这是特朗普政府采取的一项非同寻常的举措，旨在回应《纽约时报》发表的一系列关于新“空军一号”安全性的报道。

sentences.en: It was a fairly ordinary interaction, except for the fact that this is not something that is supposed to happen with reporters.
sentences.zh: 这本是一次相当普通的互动，除了这样一个事实：这不应该是记者会遇到的事情。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: We talked to one of the reporters behind those stories, White House correspondent Tyler Pager.
sentences.zh: 我们采访了这些报道背后的记者之一，白宫记者泰勒·佩格。

sentences.en: It's Friday, July 17th.
sentences.zh: 今天是7月17日，星期五。

sentences.en: Tyler, thank you for making time for us.
sentences.zh: 泰勒，谢谢你抽出时间接受我们的采访。

sentences.en: Thanks so much, Michael.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Glad to be here.
sentences.zh: 很高兴能来这里。

sentences.en: So tell us about the reporting that you and our colleagues did that sparked this unexpected
sentences.zh: 那么，请告诉我们你和我们的同事所做的报道，是什么引发了这次意想不到的

sentences.en: and very unusual response from the Trump administration, these subpoenas that the FBI has delivered to our colleagues.
sentences.zh: 且非常不寻常的特朗普政府的回应，也就是联邦调查局送给我们要同事的这些传票。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So to set the scene, Michael, the president is traveling to Turkey for the annual NATO summit.
sentences.zh: 为了交代背景，迈克尔，总统正前往土耳其参加年度北约峰会。

sentences.en: And he's doing so in his new Air Force One, the one that's been donated by Qatar.
sentences.zh: 他乘坐的是他的新“空军一号”，那架由卡塔尔捐赠的飞机。

sentences.en: And it's the first time he's taking the plane overseas.
sentences.zh: 这是他第一次乘坐这架飞机出国。

sentences.en: Well, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 嗯，非常感谢。

sentences.en: And before we begin on the plane...
sentences.zh: 在我们开始谈论这架飞机之前……

sentences.en: He had just debuted the plane earlier this month, around the July 4th, 250th birthday celebrations.
sentences.zh: 他本月初，也就是7月4日250周年庆典前后，刚刚启用了这架飞机。

sentences.en: He flew it to Mount Rushmore.
sentences.zh: 他飞往了拉什莫尔山。

sentences.en: The other plane was about 35 years old.
sentences.zh: 另一架飞机已经服役约35年了。

sentences.en: And it was time and president of the United States...
sentences.zh: 是时候了，美国总统……

sentences.en: The president had complained for years that it was embarrassing for him to show up at international
sentences.zh: 总统多年来一直抱怨说，乘坐旧飞机出席国际

sentences.en: summits on the old plane, feeling that it didn't reflect American greatness and American innovation.
sentences.zh: 峰会让他感到尴尬，他觉得这无法体现美国的伟大和创新。

sentences.en: And the president loves this new plane.
sentences.zh: 总统非常喜欢这架新飞机。

sentences.en: It's been a fixation of his to get rid of the dated Air Force One and debut this glittering jumbo jet that has been gifted to him by the country of Qatar.
sentences.zh: 他一直执着于摆脱那架过时的“空军一号”，并启用这架由卡塔尔赠送给他的闪闪发光的巨型喷气式客机。

sentences.en: And I went to Boeing, I said, who has the best one?
sentences.zh: 我去波音公司问，谁有最好的飞机？

sentences.en: They said, Qatar.
sentences.zh: 他们说，卡塔尔。

sentences.en: There's no, there's never been a plane like it.
sentences.zh: 没有，从来没有过这样的飞机。

sentences.en: Frankly, we couldn't...
sentences.zh: 坦率地说，我们无法……

sentences.en: And which he's put a lot of taxpayer money into.
sentences.zh: 而且他在上面投入了大量纳税人的钱。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So the Qatari government gives the president the plane and then they spend months and hundreds
sentences.zh: 所以卡塔尔政府把飞机送给总统，然后他们花了几个月时间和数亿

sentences.en: of millions of dollars retrofitting it because, of course, Air Force One is not any normal plane.
sentences.zh: 美元进行改装，因为当然，“空军一号”不是普通的飞机。

sentences.en: It is carrying the American president and there are a lot of modifications that need to be made to ensure that it's safe and has all the capabilities that the president may need
sentences.zh: 它搭载的是美国总统，需要进行大量改造，以确保其安全，并具备总统在任何时候可能需要的所有功能。

sentences.en: at any given time.
sentences.zh: 随时随地。

sentences.en: And the president is very excited about this plane and is eager to show it off, as are his aides that are traveling on it.
sentences.zh: 总统对这架飞机非常兴奋，急于炫耀它，随行的助手们也是如此。

sentences.en: They're posting photos and videos from inside the plane of the gold-encrusted walls and the big staircases and the plush seats and the geometric carpets.
sentences.zh: 他们在飞机内发布照片和视频，展示镶金的墙壁、大楼梯、豪华座椅和几何图案的地毯。

sentences.en: And so there's just a lot of excitement from the president and his team that this plane is ready and that he's able to take it on an overseas trip.
sentences.zh: 所以总统和他的团队非常兴奋，因为这架飞机准备就绪，他可以乘坐它进行海外旅行。

sentences.en: So here he is arriving in Turkey for a summit with fellow presidents and leaders in a plane that finally, in his mind, befits the leader of the United States.
sentences.zh: 所以他现在抵达土耳其参加峰会，与各国总统和领导人会面，乘坐的是一架在他看来终于配得上美国领导人的飞机。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So the president arrives in Turkey and I'm on the ground in Ankara covering the NATO summit.
sentences.zh: 总统抵达土耳其，我当时在安卡拉现场报道北约峰会。

sentences.en: And when he gets off the plane, he's the only world leader greeted by President Erdogan.
sentences.zh: 当他下飞机时，他是唯一一位受到埃尔多安总统迎接的世界领导人。

sentences.en: And he receives this over-the-top welcome ceremony that includes horses and the Star
sentences.zh: 他受到了极其隆重的欢迎仪式，包括马匹和由乐队演奏的《星条旗》，

sentences.en: Spangled Banner, played by a band, and fighter jets.
sentences.zh: 还有战斗机。

sentences.en: And it's a ceremony that is most comparable to the one the Pope received when he visited
sentences.zh: 这个仪式与教皇去年访问

sentences.en: Turkey last year.
sentences.zh: 土耳其时受到的礼遇最为相当。

sentences.en: Gets off a plane he thinks finally is worthy of the U.S., walks into a ceremony worthy of the president.
sentences.zh: 他走下一架他认为终于配得上美国的飞机，走进一场配得上总统的仪式。

sentences.en: And then there's just a torrent of news.
sentences.zh: 然后就是铺天盖地的新闻。

sentences.en: Overnight, a new round of U.S.
sentences.zh: 一夜之间，美国又一轮

sentences.en: attacks on Iran.
sentences.zh: 对伊朗的袭击。

sentences.en: There's the resumption of hostilities between the U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国和伊朗之间的敌对状态恢复了，

sentences.en: and Iran, which had been somewhat dormant because of the ceasefire and the ongoing negotiations.
sentences.zh: 由于停火协议和正在进行的谈判，这种状态此前曾处于某种休眠状态。

sentences.en: They want to make a deal, but they don't know how to make a deal.
sentences.zh: 他们想达成协议，但不知道如何达成。

sentences.en: And then they go around shooting ships at night.
sentences.zh: 然后他们晚上到处去炸船。

sentences.en: So the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以美国

sentences.en: and Iran are trading strikes again.
sentences.zh: 和伊朗又开始互相攻击了。

sentences.en: We can play games, but I'm not sure I want to make a deal.
sentences.zh: 我们可以玩游戏，但我不太确定我想达成协议。

sentences.en: Let's just finish the job.
sentences.zh: 让我们直接完成任务吧。

sentences.en: And the president jumps into unleashing criticisms on the NATO allies, reviving criticisms he's had for some time that NATO allies didn't do enough to support the U.S.
sentences.zh: 总统开始对北约盟国大加批评，重申了他一直以来的批评，即北约盟国在支持美国

sentences.en: in its war against
sentences.zh: 对伊朗的战争方面做得不够，

sentences.en: Iran, that countries are not meeting their defense spending requirements.
sentences.zh: 各国没有达到国防开支要求。

sentences.en: We pay far, far too much, billions and billions of dollars too much because it's unfair, because we're protecting them.
sentences.zh: 我们付出的太多太多了，几十亿几十亿地多付，因为这不公平，因为我们在保护他们。

sentences.en: So we protect them, but they're not there for us.
sentences.zh: 所以我们保护他们，但他们却不支持我们。

sentences.en: Think of it.
sentences.zh: 想想看。

sentences.en: It doesn't work.
sentences.zh: 这行不通。

sentences.en: And so there's just so much going on that the plane was sort of the story of the week before, because that's when it debuted domestically.
sentences.zh: 所以发生了太多事情，飞机算是前一周的新闻，因为那是它在国内首次亮相的时候。

sentences.en: And so there wasn't a whole lot of attention on the plane at that point because there was just so much else going on at the summit and with Iran.
sentences.zh: 所以当时对飞机的关注并不多，因为峰会和伊朗那边发生了太多其他事情。

sentences.en: When does that start to change?
sentences.zh: 这种情况什么时候开始改变的？

sentences.en: So that changes the next day when the president is scheduled to leave Turkey and return back to the United States.
sentences.zh: 第二天，当总统计划离开土耳其返回美国时，情况发生了变化。

sentences.en: It was a very short trip.
sentences.zh: 那是一次非常短暂的访问。

sentences.en: What the president announces on True Social is that the new Air Force One, the Qatari-donated
sentences.zh: 总统在“真实社交”上宣布，新的“空军一号”，即卡塔尔捐赠的

sentences.en: jet, is going to be flown from Turkey to England to an Air Force base so that troops can get an opportunity to see it.
sentences.zh: 喷气式飞机，将从土耳其飞往英国的一个空军基地，以便部队有机会参观它。

sentences.en: And the president says he will be taking the old Air Force One, which is in Turkey, not
sentences.zh: 总统说他将乘坐旧的“空军一号”，它就在土耳其，不

sentences.en: surprisingly, when the president travels overseas, they often have multiple planes and backup planes
sentences.zh: 出所料，当总统出国旅行时，他们通常会有多架飞机、备用飞机

sentences.en: and other sorts of aircraft to transport all the stuff the president needs when he's overseas.
sentences.zh: 和其他类型的飞机来运输总统在海外所需的所有物资。

sentences.en: And what the president says is that he'll be taking the old Air Force One, quote, for old time's sake.
sentences.zh: 总统说他将乘坐旧的“空军一号”，引用他的话，“为了怀旧”。

sentences.en: Which is an unexpected explanation for a president who, as you just said, Tyler, is pretty openly obsessed with the superiority of this new plane compared to the old one.
sentences.zh: 对于一位正如你刚才所说，泰勒，相当公开地痴迷于这架新飞机优于旧飞机的总统来说，这是一个出人意料的解释。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's surprising.
sentences.zh: 这很令人惊讶。

sentences.en: And immediately, there are questions about why there's this sudden, last-minute change.
sentences.zh: 人们立即开始质疑为什么会有这种突然的、最后一刻的改变。

sentences.en: Presidential trips are choreographed to the minute.
sentences.zh: 总统的行程安排精确到分钟。

sentences.en: And everything is done far in advance.
sentences.zh: 一切都是提前很久做好的。

sentences.en: Way before the president even departs the United States, there are advance teams that scout out locations and departures.
sentences.zh: 在总统离开美国之前，先遣队就已经去考察了地点和出发事宜。

sentences.en: And every piece of the president's trip is highly scheduled.
sentences.zh: 总统行程的每一个环节都经过了严密的安排。

sentences.en: So it's a surprise to see a change made so soon to his departure.
sentences.zh: 所以看到他在出发前这么快做出改变令人惊讶。

sentences.en: And people immediately start to ask questions about security.
sentences.zh: 人们立即开始询问有关安全的问题。

sentences.en: And so, Michael, remember, we are in Ankara, which is roughly 1,000 miles away from Tehran, and the war has started up again.
sentences.zh: 所以，迈克尔，记住，我们在安卡拉，距离德黑兰大约1000英里，战争又开始了。

sentences.en: And so there are questions about whether there are threats or risks to the president at a time when the U.S.
sentences.zh: 因此，人们质疑在美军对伊朗发动更多袭击且总统身处该地区时，总统是否面临威胁或风险。

sentences.en: is launching more strikes against Iran, and he's in the region.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 这似乎是自战争开始以来，总统离伊朗最近的一次。

sentences.en: This seems like the closest the president has been to Iran, perhaps, since the war began.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 此外，值得指出的是，几个月来一直有人对这架飞机的安全装置提出质疑。

sentences.en: And also, it's important to point out that there have been questions about the security apparatus on this plane for months.
sentences.zh: 议员和前军事官员曾警告说，他们担心这架飞机太快交付给总统使用。

sentences.en: Lawmakers and former military officials had been warning that they were concerned that the plane was made available to the president too soon.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，将一架飞机改装成总统乘坐的“空军一号”所需的工作量，远不止从总统获得卡塔尔喷气式飞机到他第一次乘坐它之间那几个月的时间。

sentences.en: That is, the amount of work to retrofit a plane to make it safe for the president to fly on
sentences.zh: 那么，“空军一号”上人们担心难以

sentences.en: as Air Force One requires a lot more time than the months it took from when the president acquired the Qatari jet and when he flew on it for the first time.
sentences.zh: 移植到这架卡塔尔捐赠飞机上的系统是什么？总统现在在如此紧迫的时间内就用上了它。

sentences.en: And what are the systems aboard Air Force One that folks had feared would have been difficult
sentences.zh: 总的来说，人们担心这架飞机没有配备同样的防御性反制措施，包括先进的导弹防御能力。

sentences.en: to import to this Qatari-donated plane that the president is now using in this pretty compressed time scale that he got it in?
sentences.zh: 人们告诉我们，根本没有时间把所有这些关键系统安装到飞机上，

sentences.en: So, broadly, there are concerns that there were not the same defensive countermeasures, including advanced anti-missile capabilities installed on this plane.
sentences.zh: 以确保总统拥有全方位的防御能力，保护飞机免受任何问题或威胁。

sentences.en: People told us that there just wasn't the time to put all of those critical systems on the plane
sentences.zh: 我想值得一提的是，官方的旧“空军一号”是专门为保护美国总统而建造的，

sentences.en: to ensure the president had the full scope of capabilities to protect the plane from any sort of issue or threat.
sentences.zh: 而这架卡塔尔飞机最初是为了运送大量人员享受奢华而制造的，后来才被改装以确保安全。

sentences.en: And I guess it's worth saying that Air Force One, the official old Air Force One, was specifically built for the purposes of protecting the American president,
sentences.zh: 当然，但不可避免的是，要把一些非常具体的反制技术安装到一架并非为此设计的飞机上，可能相当困难。

sentences.en: whereas this Qatari plane was originally constructed to carry lots of people in luxury and gets retrofitted to be secure.
sentences.zh: 没错，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Sure, but inevitably, it's probably quite hard to put some of those very specific countermeasure technologies onto a plane that wasn't designed for them.
sentences.zh: 事实上，如果你对比旧“空军一号”和新“空军一号”的照片，你可以在旧飞机上看到，在机翼下、尾翼上，

sentences.en: Right, Michael.
sentences.zh: 都有你在新飞机上看不到的防御系统部件。

sentences.en: In fact, if you compare photos of the old Air Force One and the new Air Force One, you can see on the old plane, under its wing, on its tail,
sentences.zh: 那么，当你开始对总统的计划为何改变以及这是否与这架飞机的安全担忧有关产生疑问时，你接下来会做什么？

sentences.en: aspects of defensive systems that you can't see on the new plane.
sentences.zh: 记住，我还在土耳其报道北约峰会，我试图弄清楚这架飞机到底怎么了，但我碰巧坐在一个巨大的礼堂里，

sentences.en: So as you start to have questions about why the president's plans have changed and whether it's related to security concerns about this plane, what do you do next?
sentences.zh: 里面有来自世界各地的数百名记者，等着特朗普出来在离开前举行最后的新闻发布会。

sentences.en: Remember, I'm still in Turkey reporting on the NATO summit, and I'm trying to figure out what's going on with this plane, but I happen to be sitting in a cavernous auditorium
sentences.zh: 这并不是进行敏感的、基于消息源的报道的理想场所。

sentences.en: with hundreds of reporters from all over the world waiting for Trump to come out and give his final press conference before leaving.
sentences.zh: 没错，那不是一个你想打电话说“嘿，我是《纽约时报》的泰勒·佩格，正在试图弄清楚‘空军一号’发生了什么”的房间。

sentences.en: Not exactly the ideal place to do sensitive, source-based reporting.
sentences.zh: 人们会偷听到的。

sentences.en: Right, not a room in which you want to call people and say, hey, it's Tyler Pager from The New York Times trying to figure out what's going on with Air Force One.
sentences.zh: 没错，这可不是个适合打电话的地方，要是你在这儿说：“嘿，我是《纽约时报》的泰勒·佩格，我想查查空军一号到底出了什么事。”

sentences.en: People would overhear that.
sentences.zh: 别人都会听见的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But very quickly, a team of reporters comes together and starts asking questions.
sentences.zh: 但很快，一组记者聚在一起开始提出问题。

sentences.en: Go ahead.
sentences.zh: 请讲。

sentences.en: Hey, Sean McCreish, New York Times.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是《纽约时报》的肖恩·麦克里什。

sentences.en: But why aren't you flying the new plane home?
sentences.zh: 但你们为什么不坐那架新飞机回家呢？

sentences.en: Say what?
sentences.zh: 你说什么？

sentences.en: Why aren't you flying on the new Air Force One home?
sentences.zh: 为什么你们不坐新的“空军一号”回家？

sentences.en: It's flying to Europe to one of the big bases, two or three of the big bases, where we can show it to the people, and we'll be going home by normal methods.
sentences.zh: 它正飞往欧洲的一个大型基地，或者两三个大型基地，我们可以在那里向民众展示它，而我们将通过正常方式回家。

sentences.en: But we...
sentences.zh: 但我们……

sentences.en: And what we learn is that the story that the president is saying on social media is not exactly what has happened.
sentences.zh: 我们了解到的是，总统在社交媒体上所说的故事与实际发生的情况并不完全相符。

sentences.en: What has happened is that the Secret Service has grown concerned about the plane and has urged the president to switch his itinerary and not take this Qatari jet out of Turkey
sentences.zh: 实际情况是，特勤局对这架飞机产生了担忧，并敦促总统改变行程，不要乘坐这架卡塔尔喷气式飞机离开土耳其，

sentences.en: and revert back to the old Air Force One.
sentences.zh: 而是改回乘坐旧的“空军一号”。

sentences.en: Which certainly suggests that they're worried that he might not be safe on the new plane flying out of Turkey in this moment.
sentences.zh: 这无疑表明他们担心他此刻乘坐新飞机离开土耳其可能不安全。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Now, we don't have that fully confirmed at that moment, but I reach out to the White House to let them know this is what we're hearing and see if they have any comment.
sentences.zh: 当时我们还没有完全证实这一点，但我联系了白宫，让他们知道我们听到的消息，看看他们是否有任何评论。

sentences.en: So, Michael, while this is happening, a senior FBI official reaches out to my colleagues in Washington and asks that we not run the story for national security reasons.
sentences.zh: 那么，迈克尔，就在这件事发生时，一位联邦调查局的高级官员联系了我在华盛顿的同事，要求我们出于国家安全考虑不要报道这个故事。

sentences.en: He doesn't specify why and also asks us to identify our sources, which we do not do.
sentences.zh: 他没有说明原因，还要求我们透露消息来源，我们拒绝了。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So, we continue to report.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们继续报道。

sentences.en: The president takes off from Turkey.
sentences.zh: 总统从土耳其起飞。

sentences.en: Then he lands in England, walks across the tarmac, and gets on the new Air Force One, the Qatari jet that was waiting for him in England.
sentences.zh: 然后他在英国降落，走过停机坪，登上了新的“空军一号”，即那架在英国等候他的卡塔尔喷气式飞机。

sentences.en: And when he gets on the new plane, he does a gaggle with the reporters on board.
sentences.zh: 当他登上新飞机时，他和机上的记者们进行了一次非正式交流。

sentences.en: What was the security concern that caused us to change planes?
sentences.zh: 导致我们更换飞机的安全隐患是什么？

sentences.en: We sent this one in.
sentences.zh: 我们派了这一架过来。

sentences.en: And he sort of downplays any security concerns.
sentences.zh: 他轻描淡写地回应了任何安全担忧。

sentences.en: Do you think there wasn't a security concern?
sentences.zh: 你认为不存在安全隐患吗？

sentences.en: No, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不。

sentences.en: Why would you?
sentences.zh: 你为什么会这么想？

sentences.en: But by the time he's doing that, me and my colleagues have confirmed that, in fact, it was a security concern that caused the change in planes.
sentences.zh: 但当他那样说的时候，我和我的同事们已经证实，事实上，确实是因为安全隐患才导致了更换飞机。

sentences.en: And we decide to publish as the president is back on the Qatari jet flying from England to Washington.
sentences.zh: 我们决定在总统乘坐卡塔尔喷气式飞机从英国飞往华盛顿的过程中发布报道。

sentences.en: If you'll permit me, I want to summarize what the story said, just so people understand.
sentences.zh: 如果允许的话，我想总结一下报道的内容，好让大家明白。

sentences.en: And the story says that Trump flew the old Air Force One out of Turkey instead of the new Qatari-donated retrofitted plane as a security precaution
sentences.zh: 报道称，特朗普为了安全起见，乘坐旧的“空军一号”离开了土耳其，而不是乘坐那架由卡塔尔捐赠并改装的新飞机，

sentences.en: related to the resumption of hostilities in Iran, and that the new plane does not have all the same features as the old one, and that the switching of the planes was done
sentences.zh: 这与伊朗敌对行动的恢复有关，而且新飞机并不具备旧飞机的所有相同功能，更换飞机是

sentences.en: at the urging of the Secret Service.
sentences.zh: 在特勤局的敦促下完成的。

sentences.en: That's what the story says.
sentences.zh: 这就是报道的内容。

sentences.en: That's correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Obviously, that contradicts the president's claim that he was on Air Force One for old time's sake.
sentences.zh: 显然，这与总统声称他为了怀旧而乘坐“空军一号”的说法相矛盾。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And it also undercuts the president's public narrative about how magnificent and special and important this new Air Force One is.
sentences.zh: 这也削弱了总统关于这架新“空军一号”是多么宏伟、特别和重要的公开叙述。

sentences.en: And what we learn in the aftermath of this story is that the president is outraged and furious that this has come out.
sentences.zh: 而在这篇报道之后，我们了解到总统对这件事的曝光感到愤怒和狂怒。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.zh: 我是维娜·刘。

sentences.en: I love my dog, and I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗，也喜欢尝试捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖尔斯基，我每天负责制作“Spelling Bee”和“Letterboxd”游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“联觉”的特质。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 立即开始游戏。

sentences.en: So, Tyler, after this reporting is published by the Times and the president absorbs it and becomes quite agitated by it, what do you come to understand happens as a result?
sentences.zh: 那么，泰勒，在《时报》发布这篇报道，总统消化了内容并因此变得相当激动之后，你认为结果发生了什么？

sentences.en: So what my colleagues learn is that Kash Patel, the FBI director, goes to the White House last week and is directed to oversee a leak investigation into our reporting.
sentences.zh: 我的同事了解到，联邦调查局局长卡什·帕特尔上周去了白宫，并被指示负责对我们的报道进行泄密调查。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: He spent roughly eight hours at the White House on Friday running the investigation there instead of the FBI headquarters, which is an enormous departure from historical practice.
sentences.zh: 他周五在白宫待了大约八个小时，在那里进行调查，而不是在联邦调查局总部，这与历史惯例有巨大的背离。

sentences.en: Historical practice would be what?
sentences.zh: 历史惯例是什么样的？

sentences.en: Well, first, that there would be complete separation between the White House and the FBI in terms of running these sorts of probes.
sentences.zh: 首先，在进行此类调查时，白宫和联邦调查局之间应该完全分离。

sentences.en: The White House is supposed to be separate from the Department of Justice, and obviously the FBI is underneath the Department of Justice.
sentences.zh: 白宫理应独立于司法部，而联邦调查局显然隶属于司法部。

sentences.en: When I covered President Biden,
sentences.zh: 当我报道拜登总统时，

sentences.en: Merrick Garland, the then attorney general, wouldn't even like to be in the same room as the president unless it was for a specific reason.
sentences.zh: 时任司法部长梅里克·加兰甚至不喜欢和总统待在同一个房间里，除非有特定原因。

sentences.en: And those norms have been completely shattered.
sentences.zh: 而这些准则已经被彻底打破了。

sentences.en: But even this is a step further, having the FBI director run an investigation out of the White House.
sentences.zh: 但即使是这样也更进一步了，让联邦调查局局长在白宫外进行调查。

sentences.en: You described what Kash Patel is overseeing as a leak investigation.
sentences.zh: 你将卡什·帕特尔负责的工作描述为泄密调查。

sentences.en: Just explain that.
sentences.zh: 请解释一下。

sentences.en: So essentially, they're trying to figure out who provided information that informed our coverage of security concerns around the new Air Force One.
sentences.zh: 本质上，他们试图找出是谁提供了信息，从而促成了我们对新“空军一号”安全隐患的报道。

sentences.en: And where this leads is the U.S.
sentences.zh: 而这导致美国

sentences.en: attorney for the Southern District of New York,
sentences.zh: 纽约南区联邦检察官，

sentences.en: Jay Clayton, issues subpoenas that FBI agents attempt to deliver to our homes on Friday evening.
sentences.zh: 杰伊·克莱顿，发出了传票，联邦调查局特工周五晚上试图将其送到我们的家中。

sentences.en: Now, in my case, I wasn't at my home in D.C.
sentences.zh: 就我而言，我当时不在华盛顿的家中。

sentences.en: I had flown directly from Turkey to New York to attend a birthday party for my mother.
sentences.zh: 我直接从土耳其飞往纽约参加我母亲的生日派对。

sentences.en: So unlike some of my colleagues, I haven't yet received the subpoena.
sentences.zh: 所以和我的某些同事不同，我还没有收到传票。

sentences.en: Well, based on what you know about the subpoenas that have been delivered, what do they actually say and what do they require?
sentences.zh: 那么，根据你对已送达传票的了解，它们到底说了什么，要求什么？

sentences.en: The subpoena calls for testimony in front of a grand jury in New York for an alleged violation of federal criminal law.
sentences.zh: 传票要求在纽约的大陪审团面前就涉嫌违反联邦刑法作证。

sentences.en: It does not have any specifics about the topic or the case, but based on who received the subpoenas, we know it was related to our coverage of Air Force One.
sentences.zh: 它没有任何关于主题或案件的具体细节，但根据收到传票的人员，我们知道这与我们对“空军一号”的报道有关。

sentences.en: That's pretty vague.
sentences.zh: 这太模糊了。

sentences.en: So is the Department of Justice with these subpoenas investigating Times journalists now?
sentences.zh: 那么司法部现在是在通过这些传票调查《时报》的记者吗？

sentences.en: So a Justice Department spokeswoman said in a statement that we are not the targets, rather, quote, those leaking classified information are.
sentences.zh: 司法部发言人在一份声明中表示，我们不是目标，相反，引用原话，“那些泄露机密信息的人才是”。

sentences.en: But Michael, I want to underscore being subpoenaed to a federal grand jury is a huge deal and something that does carry legal risks and does impact the way that we're able
sentences.zh: 但迈克尔，我想强调的是，被传唤到联邦大陪审团面前是一件大事，它确实带有法律风险，确实影响了我们

sentences.en: to do our jobs and is not something you see very often, if at all, in which journalists are called to testify.
sentences.zh: 履行职责的能力，而且记者被传唤作证的情况并不常见，甚至几乎没有。

sentences.en: There are First Amendment protections and other policies and procedures that say the Justice Department is supposed to use subpoenaing journalists as a last resort,
sentences.zh: 宪法第一修正案的保护以及其他政策和程序规定，司法部应该将传唤记者作为最后手段，

sentences.en: not a first step in a leak investigation.
sentences.zh: 而不是泄密调查的第一步。

sentences.en: And it's very rare for the Department of Justice to issue subpoenas for reporters to appear in front of a federal grand jury.
sentences.zh: 司法部向记者发出传票要求其在联邦大陪审团面前出庭是非常罕见的。

sentences.en: Gotcha.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So, here, I think we have to break the fourth wall for just a moment and acknowledge that the New York Times has lawyers and that they have responded to these subpoenas.
sentences.zh: 所以，在这里，我认为我们必须打破“第四面墙”片刻，承认《纽约时报》有律师，而且他们已经对这些传票做出了回应。

sentences.en: So, I want to read what the newsroom's top lawyer,
sentences.zh: 所以，我想读一下新闻编辑室的首席律师，

sentences.en: David McCraw, had to say about the subpoenas just a few hours after they were issued.
sentences.zh: 大卫·麦克劳，在传票发出几个小时后对这些传票的评价。

sentences.en: He said, quote, this brazen act should be seen as nothing more than an attempt to prevent the public from knowing what is happening in their country by intimidating journalists
sentences.zh: 他说，引用原话，这种厚颜无耻的行为不应被视为仅仅是试图通过恐吓记者，

sentences.en: from doing their jobs.
sentences.zh: 阻止他们履行职责，从而让公众无法了解国内正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: And so, Tyler, I want to ask you about that because these subpoenas are not occurring in a vacuum.
sentences.zh: 所以，泰勒，我想问你这个问题，因为这些传票并非在真空中发生。

sentences.en: We've reported a lot on this show and the Times has reported a lot in its pages about the Trump administration's aggressive approach toward journalists and journalism
sentences.zh: 我们在本节目中报道了很多，而《时报》也在其版面上报道了很多关于特朗普政府在第二任期内对记者和新闻业采取的激进态度。

sentences.en: in the second term.
sentences.zh: 那么，我们应该把这些传票看作是这种态度的延伸吗？

sentences.en: So, should we see these subpoenas as an extension of that?
sentences.zh: 请把这放在更大的背景下。

sentences.en: Just put this into a larger context.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 我们已经看到本届政府以各种方式向新闻机构施压的激进尝试，无论是提起诉讼、威胁提起诉讼，

sentences.en: We've seen an aggressive attempt by this administration to pressure news organizations in a variety of ways, whether that's filing lawsuits, threatening to file lawsuits,
sentences.zh: 将记者踢出随行报道总统的记者团，改变我们报道总统的方式，

sentences.en: kicking journalists out of the pool of reporters that travel and cover the president, changing the ways in which we are able to cover the president,
sentences.zh: 批评新闻机构，嘲笑他们为假新闻，以及关于美国自由媒体作用的整体言论。

sentences.en: criticizing news organizations, deriding them as fake news, just sort of the overall rhetoric about the role of a free press in the United States.
sentences.zh: 而且不仅是媒体组织和言论自由倡导者对此感到担忧。

sentences.en: And it's not just media organizations and free speech advocates that are concerned about this.
sentences.zh: 国会议员们也一样。

sentences.en: Members of Congress are too.
sentences.zh: 关于整个局势，有趣的一点是，在这些传票中扮演重要角色的两个人，

sentences.en: And one interesting thing about this whole situation is that the two men who played a big role in these subpoenas,
sentences.zh: 纽约联邦检察官杰伊·克莱顿和代理司法部长托德·布兰奇，

sentences.en: Jay Clayton, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 本周都在参议院进行了确认听证会。

sentences.en: attorney in New York, and Todd Blanche, the acting attorney general, each had confirmation hearings before the Senate this week.
sentences.zh: 克莱顿试图成为国家情报总监，而布兰奇被提名为正式的司法部长。

sentences.en: Clayton is trying to become the director of national intelligence and Blanche as nominated to serve as the official attorney general.
sentences.zh: 在这些听证会上，

sentences.en: And during those hearings,
sentences.zh: 民主党参议员们确实就传票问题对这些官员进行了严厉质询。

sentences.en: Democratic senators really laid into these officials about the subpoenas.
sentences.zh: 纽约州的克里斯汀·吉利布兰德称它们粗暴且具有攻击性。

sentences.en: Kirsten Gillibrand of New York called them rough and aggressive.
sentences.zh: 我只是想敦促说，这听起来不像我们通常预期的签发传票所需的正当独立法律程序。

sentences.en: I would just urge that this doesn't sound like the proper independent legal process that we would normally expect for issuance of a subpoena.
sentences.zh: 围绕它的特征似乎仓促、激进，且带有不必要的紧迫感。

sentences.en: The characteristics surrounding it seem rushed, aggressive, with an unnecessary urgency.
sentences.zh: 并质疑为什么传票签发得如此之快。

sentences.en: And questioned why the subpoenas were issued so quickly.
sentences.zh: 甚至不清楚你签署的传票是否遵循了政府的政策，该政策要求政府首先尽一切合理努力从其他来源获取

sentences.en: It's not even clear that the subpoenas that you signed followed the administration's policy, which requires the government to first make all reasonable attempts to obtain
sentences.zh: 信息。

sentences.en: information from other sources.
sentences.zh: 在你签署传票之前，你采取了哪些具体行动？

sentences.en: What specific actions did you take before you signed the subpoenas?
sentences.zh: 我可以告诉你……

sentences.en: I can tell you that...
sentences.zh: 俄勒冈州的罗恩·怀登询问司法部

sentences.en: Ron Wyden of Oregon asked if the
sentences.zh: 在签发传票之前是否尽了合理努力获取信息。

sentences.en: Justice Department made reasonable attempts to obtain information before they had issued the subpoenas.
